integrated_delivery.ruling: Eight weeks is the CARR Mature Foundation milestone, not the full native mature end state.

scope: Production Maturity Level 1 plus selected Level 2 controls
core Workspace and Command Center web milestone

integrated_delivery.control_room_sequence: Ship thin authoritative read-first operational visibility before mutable AgentOps; safely mutable AgentOps remains evidence- and approval-gated.
integrated_delivery.construction_gate: No production construction before Joe approves the Wednesday Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and SuperGrok 4.5 council output.

incremental_cost_bands_usd_per_month.source: CARR Mature Software End State sections 25–28; estimates remain subject to measured usage and current vendor pricing.

operating_objective.section_title: Operating objective and AI-session displacement test
operating_objective.cutover_test: Can Joe or Dell now complete and understand this routine without opening Claude Code or Codex?
operating_objective.adoption_rule: A routine is not adopted until Joe or Dell can complete and understand it without a heavy Claude Code or Codex session and the old session-driven ritual has an explicit retirement or cutover path.
operating_objective.council_criterion: The Wednesday council must reject a slice that cannot trace the objective and baseline through requirements, screens, canonical data/actions, tests, post-launch comparison, and cutover.

tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.launch_scope: One private CARR tenant with Joe and Dell only; tenant-ready safety does not authorize a public SaaS launch.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.tenant_context: The server derives authoritative tenant context from the authenticated audience, session, membership, and route binding; client or agent supplied tenant identifiers never grant or widen access.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.cross_tenant_rule: Every tenant-scoped read, write, event, evidence reference, job, and automation must fail closed when the authenticated tenant differs, including fixtures that use otherwise-valid foreign record IDs.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.workflow_promotion: Promotion is explicit, attributed, reviewable, and gated by named evidence, immutable version, accountable owner, observation window, failure criteria and handling, rollback plan, adoption result, and cutover plan; in-flight work pins its workflow version and retirement preserves audit history and a rollback or replacement path.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.bounded_trial_rule: A workflow trial must be possible in at most five business days, and may be shorter, using the governed thin primitives, with no new source of truth, destructive migration, parallel writer, or generic workflow engine.

maintenance_budget.measurement_rule: Measure actual human hours; do not invent a baseline or hide toil in agent or vendor cost.
maintenance_budget.exception_rule: Attribute material new scope, vendor or platform incidents, security events, and other approved exceptions separately from normal internal maintenance.
maintenance_budget.toil_trigger: More than five normal internal maintenance hours in each of two consecutive months creates prioritized toil-reduction work.
maintenance_budget.mature_claim_gate: The low-toil mature claim requires three complete consecutive normal months at three to five hours with required release, audit, security, backup, restore, and SLO evidence intact and exception time separately attributed.

ownership_and_commercial_exclusions: Joe retains platform ownership, intellectual property, and control.
A corporation may license owner-controlled seats only as a customer.
No public signup, self-service tenant creation, public SaaS, customer platform control, ownership transfer, or launch-scope expansion is authorized.
No generic workflow engine, plugin marketplace, customer scripting, or customer-authored executable workflow is authorized in the current program.
The amendment does not change the approved delivery timing or cost bands.
tenant_readiness_and_workflow_governance.construction_gate: These are Phase 0 contracts and fixtures only; production construction remains blocked until Joe approves the Wednesday council output.
